name: Acorn
summary: Small, round, with a cross-hatched cap.
text:
A pale wooden body under a dark cap, engraved in a cross-hatch. Small enough to sit in the palm of your hand, and it gives a low, soft light.

It comes in two sizes, and the pair costs less than two singles. Most people take both and stand them side by side.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
